G28_agent_recommendation.preferred_variant: E -- robust binary Target V3 with declared abstain semantics
G28_agent_recommendation.rationale: the phase directs that where evidence shows genuine stochastic-boundary behaviour with no bug, a prospective scientific repair is preferred over moving the threshold just above the observed failure. That is exactly what the evidence shows.

Q_answers.Q10_would_more_replicas_reduce_the_metri: NO -- disagreement probability 1 - p^R - (1-p)^R is strictly increasing in R for every p in (0,1); more replicas make gate 7 strictly harder to satisfy
Q_answers.Q11_invalid_data_or_valid_robust_negativ: VALID ROBUST-NEGATIVE LABELS. All 154 mixed aggregates across both splits carry disposition VALID_TASK_NEGATIVE and label 0, there is no GENERATION_INVALID anywhere, and the frozen protocol states that mixed outcomes set the instability flag while only numerical invalidity blocks a row
Q_answers.Q12_is_gate7_aligned_with_target_v4: COMPLEMENTARY, NOT REDUNDANT. Target V4 resolves an individual mixed aggregate conservatively; gate 7 bounds how often that happens. A structural tension exists -- disagreement is highest in the informative boundary region -- and is recorded as a design consideration for a successor protocol, not as a finding that the frozen gate is defective
Q_answers.Q14_can_v2_validation_remain_confirmator: NO -- its outcomes have been inspected repeatedly and informed this diagnosis, so under a revised protocol it is development evidence and fresh independent validation identities are required
Q_answers.Q15_cleanest_prospective_repair: a prospectively frozen robust binary Target V3 with declared abstain semantics (option E), with a calibrated probabilistic target (option D) as the scientifically richer but costlier alternative
Q_answers.Q1_is_59_over_530_reproduced_exactly: YES -- independent full-census forensic replay recomputed 59/530 = 0.1113207547 from per-replica labels
Q_answers.Q2_is_gate7_prospective_and_frozen: YES -- specification commit c17081fe dated 2026-08-03, never modified since, 14 days before official TRAIN generation; implementation frozen 2026-08-16, 32 hours before
Q_answers.Q5_which_predicate_flips: target_metric_v3_dwell_complete, in 59 of 59 unstable aggregates; co-occurring with collision_free_complete_horizon, downstream_goal_complete, safety_projection_resolved and protocol_resolved in 50 of them
Q_answers.Q6_why_f9_compact_is_stable: the disturbance is applied and perturbs every COMPACT rollout (0/530 identical final states) but never flips the outcome. COMPACT sits far from the decision boundary (positive rate 0.1038, 55 all-positive vs 475 all-negative) while LINE sits near an even split (0.4792), and an elongated LINE chain is more exposed to a moving obstacle and must also complete a transition
Q_answers.Q7_localized_or_distributed: BROADLY DISTRIBUTED across both layouts, all five team sizes, all six source policies and 48 of 120 episodes, with systematic gradients in team size and selection ordinal
Q_answers.Q8_is_the_train_validation_difference_ex: YES -- 59/530 vs 8/138 differ by 0.0533 absolute, VALIDATION has one F9 layout against TRAIN's two and a quarter the sample, its exact 95% interval [0.0254, 0.1110] reaches the TRAIN point estimate, and the same structure (stable COMPACT, low-ordinal concentration, no instability at N=5/6) appears in both
Q_answers.Q9_what_does_inference_say_and_why_does_: the one-sided exact test does not reject H0: p <= 0.10 (p = 0.2108) and the 95% interval lower bound is 0.0858, so the data are compatible with an underlying 0.10. Gate 7 nevertheless FAILS because it constrains the OBSERVED rate, not an inferred parameter, and 0.1113207547 > 0.10

verdict_text: The Gate-7 failure is scientifically real. A full-census forensic replay reproduced 59/530 exactly, found no implementation, randomness, provenance, replay or label defect, and showed the instability to be genuine two-sided stochastic boundary behaviour in F9/LINE with valid robust-negative labels. Current V2 remains blocked for training and a prospective V3 repair is recommended.
